title: Cofinite integral braces and crystallographic groups
summary: A left brace is cofinite integral (CIB) if its additive group is free abelian of finite rank and its quotient by the socle is finite. Rump introduced such braces and showed that the multiplicative group of every CIB is a crystallographic group. We study CIBs from the point of view of crystallographic groups. We prove an analogue of the Bieberbach theorems: in each dimension there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of CIBs.
